analogs.name: Atacama Desert (Yungay)
analogs.note: Hyper-arid, near-sterile soils; NASA rover and life-detection tests.

analogs.name: Haughton Crater, Devon Island
analogs.note: Polar-desert impact crater; NASA Haughton-Mars Project.

analogs.name: Death Valley
analogs.note: Evaporites, alluvial fans, extreme aridity; rover field tests.

analogs.name: McMurdo Dry Valleys
analogs.note: Coldest, driest ice-free terrain on Earth; Mars polar analog.

analogs.name: University Valley (Dry Valleys)
analogs.note: High, dry valley with ice-cemented ground under a dry surface; Mars subsurface-ice analog (Heldmann et al. 2013).

analogs.name: Holuhraun lava field
analogs.note: Fresh 2014-15 basalt flow; Mars rover and spectroscopy tests.

analogs.name: Mauna Kea
analogs.note: PISCES regolith and ISRU tests on volcanic tephra.

analogs.name: Hawaiian lava tubes (Kazumura)
analogs.note: Longest known lava tube; cave-habitat and robotics analog.

analogs.name: Río Tinto
analogs.note: Acidic, iron-rich river; jarosite like Meridiani Planum.

analogs.name: Svalbard (Bockfjord, AMASE)
analogs.note: Arctic Mars Analog Svalbard Expedition: volcanic + permafrost.

analogs.name: Mars Desert Research Station
analogs.note: Mars Society habitat; Jurassic red-bed sediments.

analogs.name: Black Point Lava Flow
analogs.note: NASA Desert RATS rover and EVA trials.

analogs.name: Lanzarote (Timanfaya)
analogs.note: ESA PANGAEA astronaut geology training; lava tubes.

analogs.name: Pilbara Craton
analogs.note: 3.5 Ga stromatolites; biosignature analog for Jezero.

analogs.name: Kīlauea
analogs.note: Active basaltic volcanism; lava-flow and tube studies.
